proceedings.מספר הליך: chart-years, chart-flow, chart-mix, chart-backlog, chart-dur, chart-dept, kpi:procs, kpi:opened, kpi:clearance, table:top, insight:trend, insight:clear, insight:backlog, insight:dur, insight:shift, insight:design, insight:dept — proceeding key (rows grouped to one record per proceeding); the opening year is parsed from its last segment and the department from its prefix when סוג תיק is empty
proceedings.סוג תיק: chart-dept, chart-years, chart-types, chart-backlog, chart-dur, insight:dept, insight:design — department; empty on every עיצוב proceeding, where the number prefix is used instead
proceedings.סוג הליך: chart-types, chart-mix, table:top, insight:type, insight:shift — procedure type; empty values shown as לא צוין, tail types bucketed into אחר
proceedings.שם הליך: table:top, insight:multi — proceeding title (mark, invention or design name), only for the trademark, patent and design departments; compensation-committee and service-invention titles name individual employees and are never shown
proceedings.מספר תיק: chart-files, table:top, insight:multi — distinct file numbers per proceeding (count only; the numbers themselves are not shown)
proceedings.הליכים קשורים: insight:linked — whether a proceeding points to related proceedings
proceedings.סטטוס: chart-status, chart-flow, chart-backlog, chart-dur, chart-heat, kpi:active, kpi:clearance, insight:clear, insight:backlog, insight:linked, insight:season — closed / merged / active
proceedings.תאריך סטטוס: chart-flow, chart-dur, chart-heat, kpi:clearance, insight:clear, insight:dur, insight:season — date of the current status: closing date for closed proceedings, merge date for merged; latest date defines the partial year
